description: This file defines the Footer controller class for the Admin section of an OpenCart application. It handles rendering the footer view, manages user authentication for displaying version information, and loads necessary scripts and language resources.

classes.name: Footer
classes.description: Controller class responsible for rendering the footer section in the admin interface, including version display and script inclusion.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to generate footer HTML, including user authentication check for displaying version, loading scripts, and rendering the footer view.
